name: rule-triage-as-asked
why: The triage-issue skill asks for the same use word for word every run.

purposes: Triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; add and remove issue labels (creating a missing triage label), and post and edit my triage comments. Never delete or rename a label, label another repository's issues, delete a comment, close, assign, or retitle an issue, push, or read secrets.
